definitions.grid: round(k * sample_rate * seconds), origin sample zero; final partial retained
definitions.percentiles: NumPy percentile method=linear, descriptive time-window distribution
definitions.contrast: p90 minus p10 of dBFS RMS of complete 1 s windows above amplitude floor
definitions.transient_proxy: peak/RMS crest in source-fixed 100 ms windows; never an attack fidelity score
definitions.excerpt_selection: up to 3 largest positive successive complete 100 ms source RMS rises; both above floor; descending rise then earliest index; >=2 s separation; fallback first eligible complete window; +/-50 ms excerpt

spectrum.normalization: one-sided PSD, |FFT|^2/(sample_rate*sum(window^2)); double interior bins; mean over complete windows
spectrum.band_edges: lower inclusive, upper exclusive; truncate at Nyquist
spectrum.bass_ms: M=(L+R)/2 and S=(L-R)/2 complex FFT; same one-sided PSD scaling; M power plus S power equals pooled channel power; coarse energy diagnostic only
spectrum.broadband: all available one-sided bins including DC and Nyquist

definitions.spectral_shape_normalization: band/bin raw power dB shift minus whole-track pooled RMS dB gain; never least-squares gain
definitions.gain: g=max(0,sum(source*master)/sum(source^2)), pooled channels, no intercept; zero-source denominator -> null; zero is constrained boundary if dot<=0
definitions.residual: master-g*source, no alignment fit; RMS uses explicit second streaming pass
definitions.correlation: pooled Pearson after separate per-channel DC centering, original sample grid
definitions.nulls: dB and ratios null if any amplitude operand<=1e-12 (power<=1e-24); no epsilon inserted into ratios; null windows remain in raw data

source_only_selection.selection: up to 3 largest positive successive complete 100 ms source RMS rises; both above floor; descending rise then earliest index; >=2 s separation; fallback first eligible complete window; +/-50 ms excerpt
